description: The Storage Box Index for a suburb: estimated monthly rent for a standardised ~9 sqm unit and parity vs the national benchmark using known ongoing rates. The index is null when no local ongoing rate is observable; promo-inclusive monthly medians are not presented as annual costs. A suburb is indexed over its suburb-page catchment, the market cheapest_storage and compare_prices read, and over all of it: `index_scope` states the basis, facility_count, observation_count and population_capped. A capital city is answered as the public index page's city scope. Rows below the implausibly-cheap floor are excluded from the rows and the market population. A row is below it when its advertised rate is under $5, or when its ongoing rate (the advertised rate if none is known) is under $7 per square metre of unit area, capped at the per-size floor (locker $20, small $20, medium $30, large $50, extra_large $80, garage_plus $50, vehicle $30). A row with no recorded area is held to the per-size floor. Rows with no recorded size and only a category name (large warehouse, office, other, small warehouse, warehouse) are left out too: their prices are unreliable.

include_observations.description: Default false: the index plus at most 25 observation rows and observations_total. True returns every observation row the index was computed from (up to the row cap).

suburb.description: Australian suburb name, e.g. 'Chatswood'. A trailing state or postcode is peeled ('Sydney 2000'). Capital cities (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Canberra, Hobart, Darwin, Gold Coast) resolve to a city-wide radius scope. On price_distribution, an otherwise-empty exact Australian locality can resolve from the packaged ABS SAL snapshot even when StoragePrices has no prices there. Every answer states how the place resolved in `place`. `place.match_type` says how the name matched (exact, token or prefix, ...); when `place.ambiguous` is true the name also matches the places in `place.other_candidates` — confirm with the user or pass state.

name: storage_box_index
